headline: Man United's Martínez issues apology for post-match outburst after meeting
description: Lisandro Martínez has issued a formal apology after criticising Manchester United's board following the 2-0 defeat to Atlético Madrid.

headline: Moisés Caicedo determined to repay faith shown by Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso
description: Moisés Caicedo is determined to repay the faith shown in him by Chelsea boss Xabi Alonso and become more of a leader on the pitch.

headline: Marc Guéhi hails Man City unity amid financial charges fallout
description: Marc Guéhi hailed Manchester City's unity in the face of adversity after a spirited fightback in the club's first home match since being found guilty of multiple breaches of the Premier League's financial regulations.

headline: Man United 'a circus' amid Lisandro Martínez rant - Roy Keane
description: Roy Keane has branded Manchester United a "circus" following Lisandro Martínez's outburst against the club's hierarchy.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Martínez's future at Man United in doubt after bust-up
description: Lisandro Martínez's future at Manchester United is in question after he pointed fingers at the club's board. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Sir Gareth Southgate rules out a return to Premier League management
description: Former England head coach Sir Gareth Southgate has said that he doesn't see a scenario where he manages a Premier League club again.
